title: Does pollution poison the mind?
text: Title: Does pollution poison the mind? Air pollution is known to be a serious health risk  — a cause of asthma, heart disease, stroke, lung cancer and a factor, according to the World Health Organization, in an estimated seven million deaths worldwide every year. A growing body of research suggests air pollution may also be harming our brains. In recent years, new areas of study have opened up into how air pollution might affect our minds and the way we think and feel.
